status: registered (the AI coach v1 is merged, including the Owner 2026-10-25 evidence rule); runnable only after the independent review of this registration and the semantics freeze; thresholds fixed here
authority: 3a-B kickoff checklist §5 (structure ✅ / behaviour ❌ / outcome ❌) and Owner 2026-10-25 P2 authorisation: the n=400 evidence was measured on balanceTool.v21 (red std, no player stats); career.v21 differs (red = AI coach, blue player stats, items/talents per flags), so the effect must be checked through the formal entry
question: Do the live v21 choices, entered through the formal career path (prepareLiveMatch with career.v21), still move the registered behaviour in the registered direction on the player's side?
tool: tools/measure_e2_3aB.mjs (--run / --report; result tools/fixtures/e2_result_3aB.json); instrument tools/lib/phaseStudySim.mjs v3 runCareerStudyMatch (the same observation code as the balance-runner path); inputs tools/lib/careerLiveInputs.mjs

seeds.path: career: odd seeds only, every seed its own effectiveSeed (check_study_seed_plan_3aB E2)

ruleset: career.v21 resolved from the golden featureFlags + mobaTacticalDirectorV21 = true; the run fails if another ruleset resolves
side: blue only: in career the player is blue and red is the AI coach; no red-side treatment exists in career

rules.claim: same-seed pairs on blue (treatment minus control); valid pairs need both values; at least 200 valid pairs, otherwise the claim is UNMEASURABLE
rules.PASS: every claim: sign matches the direction, directed z >= 3 and |rel| >= 0.05
rules.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (including UNMEASURABLE); never reported as PASS, the Owner decides
rules.reportOnly: effect size next to the balanceTool.v21 evidence; win rate, duration and gold lead (no win-rate claim)

rerun: re-run whenever the AI coach or the career.v21 assembly changes (the red side is part of the condition)
errors: errored matches are never retried or replaced and are listed by seed; any errored match => at most INCONCLUSIVE; more than 1% of the planned matches errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
instrumentCheck: every record (live and again at report time): career.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, engine seed = seed, red = AI coach binding, phaseStudySim.v3, empty selfCheck, and no blue choice dropped (droppedChoices empty); any failure => HALT / STOP(INSTRUMENT)
